data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘kula’ meaning ‘family’ and ‘deep’ meaning ‘deep well’. This name signifies a deep well of knowledge and wisdom within the family. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
